title: A missile from the Mojave
text: The Sidewinder air-to-air missile came out of China Lake, then called the Naval Ordnance Test Station. Scientists and engineers there developed the AIM-9 version of the Sidewinder in 1950. William McLean led the project team developing it from 1945 to 1954. Its variants and upgrades are still in active service.
